intro: Magga is an orc resident living in the dusty settlement of Razor Hill within Durotar. Stationed near the town's lively tavern, she serves as a welcoming face for newly arrived Horde adventurers making their way out of the Valley of Trials.

sections.t: A Welcoming Face in Razor Hill
p: Razor Hill serves as the first real taste of the wider world for young orcs and darkspear trolls emerging from the Valley of Trials. Positioned right beside the local inn, Magga greets new arrivals to the outpost. While she keeps a low profile among the outpost's busy grunts and tradespeople, she helps bind the small settlement together.
